description: This Java source file defines a utility class 'FastMathLiteralArrays' that loads tabulated data for exponential calculations used by the 'FastMath' class in the Apache Commons Math library. It contains large arrays of precomputed exponential values at integer points with some NaN placeholders.

classes.name: FastMathLiteralArrays
classes.description: A utility class providing lookup tables for exponential function approximations used internally in FastMath.

methods.name: None
methods.description: Contains only static final arrays; no explicit methods are defined.

methods.name: loadExpIntA
methods.description: Returns a clone of the EXP_INT_A array containing precomputed exponential integer parts.

methods.name: loadExpIntB
methods.description: Returns a clone of the EXP_INT_B array containing precomputed exponential fractional parts.

methods.name: loadExpFracA
methods.description: Returns a clone of the EXP_FRAC_A array for fractional exponential approximations.

methods.name: loadExpFracB
methods.description: Returns a clone of the EXP_FRAC_B array for fractional exponential approximations.

methods.name: loadLnMant
methods.description: Returns a clone of the LN_MANT 2D array containing extended precision logarithm values over the range 1-2.
